sections.title: Core
sections.summary: The adapter configs, `PeftModel` and its task classes, and the `AutoPeftModel` loaders that reopen a saved adapter with its base model.

sections.title: LoRA family
sections.summary: A low-rank update learned beside each frozen weight, and the variant that moves rank between layers while it trains.

packages.label: LoRA
packages.citation: Hu, Edward J., et al. "LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models." arXiv:2106.09685, 2021.

packages.label: AdaLoRA
packages.citation: Zhang, Qingru, et al. "Adaptive Budget Allocation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning." arXiv:2303.10512, 2023.

sections.title: Orthogonal family
sections.summary: A rotation of each layer's input space instead of an addition to its weight: block-diagonal Cayley rotations (OFT), their butterfly factorisation (BOFT) and a chain of Householder reflections (HRA).

packages.label: OFT
packages.citation: Qiu, Zeju, et al. "Controlling Text-to-Image Diffusion by Orthogonal Finetuning." arXiv:2306.07280, 2023.

packages.label: BOFT
packages.citation: Liu, Weiyang, et al. "Parameter-Efficient Orthogonal Finetuning via Butterfly Factorization." arXiv:2311.06243, 2023.

packages.label: HRA
packages.citation: Yuan, Shen, et al. "Bridging the Gap between Low-rank and Orthogonal Adaptation via Householder Reflection Adaptation." arXiv:2405.17484, 2024.

sections.title: LyCORIS family
sections.summary: A weight-shaped update built from a structured factorisation: a Hadamard product of low-rank products (LoHa) or a Kronecker product (LoKr).

packages.label: LoHa
packages.citation: Hyeon-Woo, Nam, et al. "FedPara: Low-Rank Hadamard Product for Communication-Efficient Federated Learning." arXiv:2108.06098, 2021.

packages.label: LoKr
packages.citation: Yeh, Shih-Ying, et al. "Navigating Text-To-Image Customization: From LyCORIS Fine-Tuning to Model Evaluation." arXiv:2309.14859, 2023.

sections.title: Prompt learning
sections.summary: An input learned instead of a weight, with no layer added to the model: virtual tokens in front of the embeddings, virtual keys and values in every attention layer, tokens an encoder produces, or one prompt shared across tasks.

packages.label: Prompt Tuning
packages.citation: Lester, Brian, et al. "The Power of Scale for Parameter-Efficient Prompt Tuning." arXiv:2104.08691, 2021.

packages.label: Prefix Tuning
packages.citation: Li, Xiang Lisa, and Percy Liang. "Prefix-Tuning: Optimizing Continuous Prompts for Generation." arXiv:2101.00190, 2021.

packages.label: P-Tuning
packages.citation: Liu, Xiao, et al. "GPT Understands, Too." arXiv:2103.10385, 2021.

packages.label: Multitask Prompt Tuning
packages.citation: Wang, Zhen, et al. "Multitask Prompt Tuning Enables Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning." arXiv:2303.02861, 2023.

sections.title: Shared-table tuners
sections.summary: One set of tensors for the whole model, such as random projections or a vector bank, held once by the tuner; each layer adds only a few parameters of its own.

packages.label: VeRA
packages.citation: Kopiczko, Dawid J., et al. "VeRA: Vector-based Random Matrix Adaptation." arXiv:2310.11454, 2023.

packages.label: RandLoRA
packages.citation: Albert, Paul, et al. "RandLoRA: Full-rank Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Models." arXiv:2502.00987, 2025.

packages.label: VB-LoRA
packages.citation: Li, Yang, et al. "VB-LoRA: Extreme Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning with Vector Banks." arXiv:2405.15179, 2024.

sections.title: Structured and sparse updates
sections.summary: A weight update with a fixed structure other than low rank: a few frequency-domain coefficients (FourierFT), block-circulant blocks (C3A), shared shards (MiSS, and Bone, the method it replaced) or a sparse subset of the weight itself (SHiRA).

packages.label: FourierFT
packages.citation: Gao, Ziqi, et al. "Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning with Discrete Fourier Transform." arXiv:2405.03003, 2024.

packages.label: C3A
packages.citation: Chen, Aochuan, et al. "Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning via Circular Convolution." arXiv:2407.19342, 2024.

packages.label: MiSS
packages.citation: Kang, Jiale, et al. arXiv:2409.15371, 2024 (the paper that introduced Bone, revised as MiSS).

packages.label: Bone
packages.citation: Kang, Jiale. arXiv:2409.15371, 2024 (the paper that introduced Bone; MiSS is its successor).

packages.label: SHiRA
packages.citation: Bhardwaj, Kartikeya, et al. "Sparse High Rank Adapters." arXiv:2406.13175, 2024.

sections.title: Scaling and selective tuning
sections.summary: Methods that train a small part of the model itself: a learned rescaling vector per layer (IA3), a trainable copy of each chosen normalisation layer (LN tuning), or a few rows of an embedding table (trainable tokens).

packages.label: IA3
packages.citation: Liu, Haokun, et al. "Few-Shot Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning is Better and Cheaper than In-Context Learning." arXiv:2205.05638, 2022.

packages.label: LN Tuning
packages.citation: Zhao, Bingchen, et al. "Tuning LayerNorm in Attention: Towards Efficient Multi-Modal LLM Finetuning." arXiv:2312.11420, 2023.

sections.title: Utilities
sections.summary: Entry points that adapt a model without wrapping it, the adapter state-dict helpers, and the status reports of a model's adapter layers.

guides.title: Fine-Tune with LoRA
guides.summary: A runnable tutorial: adapt a zoo model, train only the adapter, save and reload it, switch it off, merge it, hold several adapters, export to Core ML — and a map of the other methods.

guides.title: Coming from the reference adapter library
guides.summary: What carries over unchanged — names, config fields, the adapter file — and the few places a port needs a second look.
